results.rationale: The heel hole is fully filled with matching dark knit, completing the sock. The foot silhouette, ankle, remaining fabric and dark surface are unchanged. Knit texture and shading make the repair visually natural without a noticeable seam.

The blue-and-cream carton, cap, milk lettering, cow graphic and white background retain their identities. The view remains three-quarter with a broad MILK face visible; the reference instead shows the cow side straight on with a symmetric triangular roof and mostly hidden cap. The carton itself is clean and geometrically coherent.
